Starlink helped bring a missing hiker to safety in California. ♥️

A 44-year-old woman got separated from her hiking partner on the way down Mount Conness. He went back to look for her, then used Starlink to reach rescuers.

Ground teams searched through the night, and helicopters joined at first light. Rescuers found her that morning and treated her.

This is why Starlink matters. It brings internet to places where normal cell phones don’t work, so people can get help when they really need it.
